note: The one source of initialize.capabilities.remote (remote_flags.rs). Each flag of Node's relay challenge (remote-relay-client-lifecycle.ts:117-151 at b6f10295a) with the Node calls it opens on the phone's page (remote-shim-api.ts and its readers). A call served for a phone end to end names the core method its phone adapter calls (`method`); a call that is not names who brings it (`owner`). A flag is on only when every call names a method and nothing else waits (`unserved`); nativePush also needs the relay to offer native platforms. apps/desktop/src/renderer/remote-flags.test.mjs fails when a call names a method no bundled adapter claims, or an owner while an adapter claims it; remote_flags.rs's tests fail when a method is not in the method table for a relay connection.
